Add Extra Desktops: Keep work, cozy gaming, and browsing separated so your screen never feels cluttered (Swipe up with three fingers on your trackpad > click the + in the top right). 🎛️ 3. Customize Your Menu Bar: Hide the icons you never click and pin the controls you actually use (System Settings > Control Center, or hold Command and drag icons around). 🕰️ 4.
